pou.name: FB_Bronkhorst_SingleDevice

st.body: Output_DeviceInstance.alarm_info := Input_alarm_info;

(* SV Requests *) IF NOT cfg_pending AND setpoint_mode_allowed THEN
CASE Input_DeviceType OF
ELFLOW, CORIFLOW: sv_changed := ABS(Input_DeviceInstance.SVreq - Input.SV) >= 0.001; ELPRESS: sv_changed := ABS(Input_DeviceInstance.SVreq - Input_p_SV_mbarg) >= 1.0;
END_CASE
IF sv_changed THEN sv_req := Input_DeviceInstance.SVreq; ACT_Reset_SV_Lifecycle; (* Lebenszyklus neu starten *) sv_pending := TRUE; END_IF
END_IF
Input_p_SV_mbarg := Input.SV*1000-1000; (* mbar(g) *) Input_p_AV_mbarg := Input.AV*1000-1000;
Output_DeviceInstance.SVreq := sv_req;
Input_alarm_info := BH_AlarmBitTOAlarmArray(Input.AlarmInfo);
